description_en: Retrieves the diagnostic result for a single card
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc get-diagnose-result-for-single-card --diagnose-task-id diagnoseTask-bp2qhwdp2n9x6zkvq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDiagnoseResultForSingleCard

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network diagnostic task
parameters.name: diagnose_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Cloud Connector instance.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html
parameters.help_zh:
网络诊断的云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

BeginTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp for the start of the diagnosis. Unit: seconds
BeginTime.description_zh: 网络诊断的开始时间戳。单位：秒

CardIp.description_en: The source IP address of the card
CardIp.description_zh: 网络诊断的源端卡的IP地址

Destination.description_en: The destination IP address or domain name of the diagnosis
Destination.description_zh: 网络诊断的目的IP或者域名

Part.description_en:
The name of the diagnosed component. Valid values:

CCIOT: Cloud Connector.

Card: IoT card.

Terminal: terminal.

Server: server.

Apn: APN
Part.description_zh:
诊断的部件名称。取值：
CCIOT：云连接器。

Card：物联网卡。

Terminal：终端。

Server：服务器。

Apn：APN

Status.description_en:
The status of the diagnosed component. Valid values:

Normal: The component is working as expected.

Wrong: An error occurred on the component.

Unknown: The status of the component is unknown
Status.description_zh:
诊断部件的状态。取值：

Normal：表示诊断状态正常。

Wrong：表示诊断状态错误。

Unknown：表示诊断状态未知

EndTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp for the end of the diagnosis. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 网络诊断的结束时间戳。单位：秒

ErrorLevel.description_en:
The severity level of the issue. Valid values:

Error: an error.

Warning: a warning
ErrorLevel.description_zh:
诊断问题的级别。取值：

Error：表示错误。

Warning：表示警告

ErrorPart.description_en:
The component where the issue occurred. Valid values:

CCIOT: The issue is with the Cloud Connector instance.

Card: The issue is with the Internet of Things (IoT) card.

Terminal: The issue is with the terminal.

Server: The issue is with the server.

Apn: The issue is with the Access Point Name (APN)
ErrorPart.description_zh:
诊断问题的组件。取值：

CCIOT：表示诊断的问题为云连接器的问题。

Card：表示诊断的问题为物联网卡的问题。

Terminal：表示诊断的问题为终端的问题。

Server：表示诊断的问题为服务器的问题。

Apn：表示诊断的问题为APN的问题

ErrorSuggestion.example: Please check whether the terminal and card are compatible or whether the terminal can send messages

IccId.description_en: The ID of the source card

IoTCloudConnectorId.description_en: The ID of the Cloud Connector instance
IoTCloudConnectorId.description_zh: 网络诊断的云连接器实例ID

Status.description_en:
The status of the network diagnostic task. Valid values:

success: The diagnosis is successful.

failed: The diagnosis failed.

diagnosing: The diagnosis is in progress
Status.description_zh:
网络诊断任务的状态。取值：

success：表示诊断成功。

failed：表示诊断失败。

diagnosing：表示诊断中
